compiled_state.description:
## What
Create plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/consult-recipe-registry.sh — a bash helper that reads plugins/dso/recipes/recipe-registry.yaml and outputs a formatted capability summary.

## Why
TDD GREEN phase: implement the script to make the RED tests from db34-97ab pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/consult-recipe-registry.sh and is executable (chmod +x)
- With no arguments: outputs all recipes, one per line, format: NAME (LANGUAGE) [SCOPE]: CAPABILITY_DESCRIPTION
- With --language <lang>: filters output to recipes matching that language only
- With --recipe <name>: filters output to recipes matching that name only
- Missing registry file (REGISTRY_PATH override via env var for testing) exits 1 with error to stderr
- All tests in tests/scripts/test-consult-recipe-registry.sh pass
- Uses grep/awk/sed only (no external tools); registry path defaults to $(dirname "$0")/../../recipes/recipe-registry.yaml relative to script location (or RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH env override for tests)

## File Impact
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/consult-recipe-registry.sh

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make failing tests from db34-97ab pass

## Dependencies
- db34-97ab (RED tests must exist first)
